# Release Notes — Documentation Excellence 4.6 R3.2

Generated instructions now use one consistent Presentation Grammar in both
Document Workspace and Word.

## User-visible improvements

- Actions remain easy-to-read normal text.
- Business Central fields, pages, actions and other interface labels appear in
  quotation marks.
- Values entered or selected by the user appear in bold.
- Keyboard shortcuts and technical identifiers use monospace.
- Selection wording places the interface element before its value, while field
  entry keeps the value before the destination field.
- Known checkbox intent is expressed as activate or deactivate instead of a
  mechanical Yes/No assignment.

Examples:

- `Välj **136** i "Nr"` becomes `Välj "Nr"` **136**.
- `Ange **500** i Antal` becomes `Ange` **500** `i "Antal"`.
- `Sätt "Spärrad" till **Nej**` becomes `Inaktivera "Spärrad"`.

## Compatibility

No Review migration is needed. Source events, workflow, screenshots,
annotations, profiles and planner behavior are unchanged. Older instruction
markers remain supported, and plain accessible sentences contain no formatting
artifacts.
